qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: General construction contracting with no defensible structural moat. Competitive tendering, low switching costs, and fixed-price contract risks keep operating margins paper-thin (2-3%) and multi-cycle returns on capital volatile.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat Archetype 'None' & ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Dutch civil and commercial construction contractor operates on razor-thin operating margins (2-3%) in commoditized competitive bidding with fixed-price project overruns.
qualitative.evidence: Adjusted EBITDA margins of ~5% translate to GAAP operating margins of 2-3%. Historical earnings have suffered periodic severe contract write-downs and restructuring losses, with multi-cycle ROIC far below the 12% threshold.
